what: a join of a ring and an arm whose R5 convex tip stops 0.01 mm short of the ring's outer wall: nothing overlaps, so nothing fuses
method: ring pi*(30^2-24^2)*6 and arm 6*(350+12.5*pi) are 0.01 mm apart (arm tip at x=30.01): the join has nothing to fuse, so V is the sum of the two and the arm stays a separate shell. A combine's join of a tool that meets no target keeps it in the target as a separate lump (crates/doc eval.rs, Operation::Join; engine test join_meeting_nothing_keeps_the_first_body), and the tool body is consumed: one body (Ring) of two shells
